map.State: Idle: CSS, Highlight: highlight, Pressed: runtime, not a prop

theme.about: boosty (cyan/magenta on black), dark or light. Any --tk-gamepad-* property overrides one colour.

glyphs.about: Face-button marks: letters (A/B/X/Y), shapes or numbers. Positions never change.

highlight.about: Space-separated positional names to outline, e.g. "up" or "south east".

pulse.about: Breathe the highlight (off under prefers-reduced-motion and `calm`).

calm.about: No motion at all, whatever the OS says.

size.about: A multiple of 340px (1.5) or any CSS length ("100%", "12rem").

source.about: "live" reads the Gamepad API, "replay" plays a timeline; unset uses `state`.

index.about: With source="live": which pad (navigator.getGamepads() index); unset = first connected.

status.about: Show a one-line status (connected pad, raw mapping, replay time).

state.about: Hand-fed state when there is no source.

replay.ts: Replay | { frames: ReplayFrame[]; map?: ReplayMap; hold?: nu
replay.about: A createReplay() result or { frames, map, hold }.
